# Bridgespan

> > Bridgespan is a global consulting firm specializing in strategy, impact, and organizational effectiveness for nonprofits, foundations, and philanthropists.

Bridgespan provides mission-driven consulting services across the nonprofit and philanthropic sectors, with offices in Boston, New York, San Francisco, Washington DC, and regional hubs in India, Africa, and Southeast Asia. The organization works with foundations, individual donors, nonprofits, and NGOs to drive social change through strategic advisory, capacity building, and impact measurement.

## Key Topics

- Philanthropy
- Nonprofit Strategy
- Nonprofit Consulting
- Social Change
- Impact Measurement
- Nonprofit Funding
- NGO Support
- Leadership Development
- Impact Investing
- Social Sector
- Grantmaking
- Organizational Effectiveness
- Capacity Building
- Equity
- Global Development

## Core Services

- [Our Services](https://www.bridgespan.org/our-services): Bridgespan services overview: consulting, strategy, leadership development.
- [Advising Philanthropy for Greater Social Impact](https://www.bridgespan.org/our-services/philanthropy): Bridgespan philanthropy services: foundation advising, grantmaking, social change.
- [Helping Foundations with Strategy and Grantmaking](https://www.bridgespan.org/our-services/helping-foundations-with-strategy-and-grantmaking): Bridgespan foundation strategy consulting: grantmaking, equity lens, capacity building.
- [Supporting Individuals and Families with Philanthropy Consulting](https://www.bridgespan.org/our-services/supporting-individuals-and-families-with-philanthropy-consulting): Bridgespan family philanthropy consulting: grantmaking, impact measurement, equity.
- [Supporting Nonprofits and NGOs with Strategy and Growth](https://www.bridgespan.org/our-services/supporting-nonprofits-and-ngos-with-strategy-and-growth): Bridgespan nonprofit/NGO consulting: strategy, growth, organizational effectiveness.
- [Helping Your Nonprofit and NGO with Funding Strategy](https://www.bridgespan.org/our-services/helping-your-nonprofit-and-ngo-with-funding-strategy): Bridgespan nonprofit funding strategy: sustainable models, fundraising, scaling.
